purpose: scoped review quality and autonomous completion, not a fixed exhaustive geometry list or human acceptance
shared: Native discovery and actual output evidence for all three context documents
One autonomous review turn after preparation finishes within the preregistered 180 seconds; no repeated continuation or hints
Concrete objects, role-appropriate visible references, supported observations and bounded conclusions
No unsupported defect or forced normalization of meaningful padding, state, hierarchy or responsive differences
No static-image claim that interaction, real font loading, exact contrast or full accessibility passed

A.expectation: Find the visible name header versus five title start offset; do not guess exact correction or implementation cause
Explicitly compare the operation header and five More labels, treating the repaired visible alignment as normal
Compare the pale filled second checkbox with other hollow checkboxes and link that visible difference to the read-only/non-batch helper; actual selection behavior remains unknown
Check multiline title/helper grouping and row correspondence using the whole content block rather than forcing first-line alignment or equal title spacing
Use an appropriate column reference for bordered/filled tags; stable inner padding need not align directly to the header; no invented inset defect
Check repeated and different publishing states: two published green and three draft gray, without claiming business state correctness

B.expectation: Check visible field label/control grouping and stable reading starts using appropriate control edges; do not force input text to the external label edge
Observe author/publisher side-by-side on desktop and stacked in narrow view; do not demand a fixed column count
Check visible primary save versus cancel/close and helper grouping; no claim of successful save or keyboard behavior

Recognize that lower fields/textarea are not fully shown in the narrow screenshot; reserve scroll reachability and footer obstruction for interaction, rather than declare data inaccessible or fully usable
If discussing blue emphasis or required stars, preserve their apparent state/field role and do not call them arbitrary alignment defects without evidence

knownLimits: Primary grading is not blind or an objective exhaustive universe. Criteria were revised before these runs after independent audit; do not backfit old scores or attribute all differences to Skill alone. New B is a previously unused object for this execution-validation series, not a new live render.
